description: Open a score; decoded cap 8 MiB, subject to lower transport line budget.
name: score_open

description: Create from exactly one engine template.
name: score_create

description: Destroy on owner thread; captured jobs remain independent.
name: score_close

description: Read structure and source revision; expected_revision guards the read.
name: score_outline

description: Queued reads; expected_revision guards pagination. Layout addresses are ephemeral.
name: score_query

description: Decode entire batch before one atomic edit. OpRefs name earlier ops only. Opaque is read-only.
name: score_edit

description: run waits; start queues. Capture source revision. Select master or excerpt for score, render, audio and positions. PNG/SVG require a directory with page-0001.ext names. Stage all; failed publication returns Io/published_artifacts and cleans remaining staging. Positions map Document::positions measure/segment to JSON page_size, elements and events: page-local 1200-DPI geometry, result-local element IDs and repeat-expanded milliseconds; see docs/dev/a5-registry.md.

native_version.description: Requested native version; supported: 5.00 (default), 4.70. Other values are rejected by the engine with export warnings.

name: score_export

description: Inspect runtime or add_font(path)/set_soundfonts(files) on owner thread. Empty files disables audio. Changes preserve document revisions; fonts trigger relayout. Existing jobs retain captured immutable assets; sample rate stays fixed.
name: runtime_info

description: Inspect or cancel retained job; terminal cancellation is idempotent.
name: runtime_job
